srf/1.1/b/responsible-telco.note: not_member for an MVNO subscriber (A18). Recorded beside the Telco tier; the tier gates on 7.7, not on this.

srf/1.4/read-with-legislation.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/2.1/protected-account/a/individuals.note: The SRF's limb: individuals only. A sole proprietor is not_member here and a member under the EUPG (A1).

srf/2.1/protected-account/d/psp-emoney.note: not_applicable means the issuer is not a relevant payment service provider, where limb (d) never arises.

srf/2.1/protected-account.note: One failing limb decides not_satisfied; satisfied needs all four affirmative (limb (d) may be not_applicable by its own words).

srf/2.1/seemingly-authorised/d/unintende.note: affirmed means the account user did not intend the transactions. not_assessed is a person's absence, not a finding.

srf/7.1.1/relevant-claim.note: One affirmative scope failure is not_relevant whatever the others; relevant_claim needs all four affirmative.

srf/2.1/high-risk-activities.supplies: An activity outside the four is not a high-risk activity for the cooling-off and alert duties under the SRF, though it may be one under the EUPG (ambiguity A13).

srf/2.1/money.supplies: Excludes digital payment tokens from every clause that says `payment transaction`.

srf/2.1/sms.supplies: Only `sms` in the contact-platform enumeration is an SMS; `whatsapp`, `social_media` and `other_digital` are not.

srf/2.1/sender-id-sms.supplies: 5.2.1 and 5.2.2 arise only when the phishing SMS carried an alphanumeric sender ID.

srf/2.1/subscriber.supplies: The Telco's duty runs to its subscriber; whether the subscriber is the account holder is a separate fact 6.6 tests.

srf/2.2/undefined-expressions.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

eupg/2.1/unauthorised-transaction.supplies: Limb (d) carries footnote 4(a): an intended payment is outside the SRF even where every other limb holds.

eupg/2.1/access-code.supplies: A one-time password sent by SMS is an access code; a card security number printed on the card is not.

eupg/2.1/protected-account/a/sole-propri.supplies: A sole proprietor's claim is inside the EUPG and, on the SRF's words, outside the SRF.

srf/4.1/eupg-s4-applies.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/4.2.1/cooling-off.note: The 12-hour floor and the block on high-risk activities are the FI's recorded assessments (F-05). not_applicable: no token activated and no PSP new-device login.

srf/4.2.1/fn5/non-stp-activation.supplies: The cooling-off clock may start before activation completes.

srf/4.2.2/ii/new-device-login-alert.note: not_applicable for a bank-issued account, or a PSP-issued account with no new-device login.

srf/4.2.2/alerts.note: breached if any limb was; not_applicable only if all three never arose; satisfied needs every limb satisfied or never arisen; else undetermined.

eupg/2.1/transaction-notification-thresh.rests_on: a meaning supplied by the institution, not by the Guidelines

srf/4.2.3/above-threshold.note: Selects the limb by whether the holder set a threshold. The _on_supplied_meaning tokens are carried, not laundered (F-08: the attribution stops at 4.2.3).

srf/4.2.3/outgoing-transaction-notificat.note: not_applicable: the holder did not instruct notifications, or the transaction was below the applicable threshold (A20). Whether the threshold rested on a supplied meaning is visible on srf/4.2.3/above-threshold, not here (F-08).

srf/4.2.4/duty.note: No precondition: this duty is never not_applicable.

srf/4.4/fraud-surveillance-commencement.note: in_force when the transaction executed on or after 16 June 2025 (Singapore time). missing_operand: no execution instant recorded.

srf/4.2.5/response.note: not_applicable: the account was not rapidly drained of a material sum. undetermined: nobody assessed whether it was.

srf/4.2.5/duty.note: not_applicable before 16 June 2025 (4.4). From commencement: surveillance in place is unconditional and the response is required only on a rapid drain.

srf/4.3/scheduled-downtime.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/6.4/a/fi-complied-all.note: satisfied only on five affirmative results; a never-arisen duty composes under A3's supplied resolution and blocks the tier unresolved.

srf/6.2/any-fi-breach.note: true on one established breach whatever the others; false only on five affirmative non-breach results.

srf/6.3/fi-responsible-notwithstanding.note: satisfied: 5.5(a) or (b) affirmed AND the loss arose from it. not_satisfied on an affirmative denial of both, or of causation.

srf/7.7/perpetrated-through-sms.note: The Telco tier arises only on `sms`. An OTT message is not_sms (2.1 `SMS`).

srf/5.1/imda-directions-prevail.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/5.2.1/deliver-only-from-authorised-a.note: not_applicable: not perpetrated through SMS, or the SMS carried a telephone number rather than a Sender ID.

srf/5.2.2/block-unauthorised-sender-id.note: Arises only for a Sender ID SMS from an unauthorised source; breached when it was delivered. One unauthorised delivery breaches 5.2.1 and 5.2.2 together (A25).

srf/5.2.3/designated-database.rests_on: a meaning supplied by the institution, not by the Guidelines

srf/5.2.3/this-sms-blocked.note: A5's second reading, as its own record. not_applicable: the URL was not listed at delivery (A6).

srf/5.2.3/duty.note: Guarded on A5; unresolved, undetermined. `designated` on a supplied meaning composes as designated (the attribution is on srf/5.2.3/designated-database; F-08).

srf/6.4/b/any-telco-breach.note: Outside the Telco tier every input is not_applicable and this is false; srf/6.4/telco-bears gates on 7.7 before reading it.

srf/6.6/subscriber-not-account-holder.note: not_applicable: the subscriber is the account holder. breached: the subscriber differs and (a) or (b) fails, so the Telco does not bear under 6.6.

srf/6.4/telco-bears.note: not_applicable: not perpetrated through SMS. telco_not_liable when the FI did not comply with all of 4.2 (6.5), or on five affirmative non-breach findings, or on an affirmative denial of causation or of 6.6 AFTER a breach is established. An undetermined 5.2 duty blocks the tier before causation is read. telco_bears on affirmative findings only.

srf/6.5/fi-first.supplies: fi_bears dominates every Telco-tier result, including undetermined.

srf/6.1/fn11/loss-excludes-consequential.supplies: `total loss` in 7.13 and 7.14 is the sum of the seemingly authorised transactions.

srf/6.8/redress.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/6.9/joint-accounts.supplies: One outcome for the account, binding all holders.

srf/3.1/no-links.note: affirmed means the user clicked an unexpected link. Not read by Section 6 (A19).

eupg/5.2/recklessness.note: EUPG liability, not SRF allocation. Not read by Section 6 (A19).

srf/7.1/four-stage-workflow.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/7.3/report-within-30-days.note: The SRF clock: from the FI sending the first alert (A8a). No Section 6 consequence is encoded (A8).

srf/7.3/fn14/reasons-for-delay.note: not_applicable: the report was in time, or the FI did not ask.

srf/7.3/email-and-information-within-3-d.note: no_email: no valid email address was furnished. Otherwise elapsed_within's tokens over the 3 days from the report.

srf/7.6/out-of-scope-route.note: not_applicable: a relevant claim, which Section 6 allocates.

srf/7.7.1/concurrent-investigation.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/7.9/investigation-timeline.note: The limit is selected by the FI's recorded classification; unrecorded is undetermined, never 21. Weekdays only (A28).

srf/7.9/fn16/retention.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

srf/7.11/recourse.why: directs an act; no fact of the claim makes it true or false, so it has no result domain

eupg/1.5/deferred-commencement.note: in_force when the transaction executed on or after 16 June 2025 (Singapore time).

srf/7.13/fi-credits.note: Arises only on an fi_bears outcome.

srf/7.14/telco-credits.note: Arises only on a telco_bears outcome.

eupg/3.20/police-report-within-3-days.note: outstanding: requested, not yet furnished, 3 days still running. out_of_order (furnished before the request) satisfies.

eupg/4.11/holder-preference.supplies: A transaction the holder instructed the FI not to notify is outside 4.2.3.
